rationale: The proposed topology improves the binding constraints—particularly NF and Idd—by replacing the resistive load (R1) with a parallel LC tank at the output, enhancing gain and input match while reducing DC current. This resonant load provides frequency selectivity at 3.5 GHz, improving S21 and S11 by increasing output impedance at the desired frequency and reducing the quiescent current through the PMOS. The inductor also enables better noise performance by increasing the effective transconductance-to-current ratio, directly lowering NF. The addition of a single inductor is within the allowed device budget and maintains stability margins.
